maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from making and selling packaged beverages, which are consumables used up, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Sells Coca-Cola beverages to retailers, restaurants and venues, paid by businesses and consumers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grew by selling beverages and territory expansions, with some large franchise territory deals, but not a steady roll-up of many acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Customers sell soft drinks that can be substituted by other beverage suppliers; switching is easy, though exclusive Coca-Cola franchise territory limits Coke supply.

notes: Coke-brand supply is territory-exclusive, so mission-critical is a borderline call.
